My thanks to @cameronglover_ for the shout out to my book Disrupting The Bystander: When #MeToo Happens Among Friends on @sfsepodcast! I'm so glad it served you! 
https://t.co/Oo7VzfAtaV

Disrupting the Bystander: When #metoo Happens Among Friends is a primer on what neuroscience can teach us about supporting one another in confronting harm, outside of a carceral framework and beyond disposability culture:
https://t.co/f6ff3Xvimw
@TronClaudVanDam I'd be happy to send you a copy of my book Disrupting The Bystander: When #MeToo Happens Among Friends, if you are interested!
